entries.27f7bcae3e35f4e9: Based on its company motto, "Foresighted Originality and Research," and its corporate philosophy, it has set a long-term vision of "growing into a distinctive life and health-related corporate group that is recognized for its value globally by meeting medical and health needs," and in 2022 it formulated "Our Desired Image for 2031" to make this concrete. In fiscal 2025, it formulated the 25-27 Medium-Term Management Plan, positioning this period as "Three Years to Accelerate Growth Strategies," and is working on three key themes: "strengthening the earnings power of core businesses," "continuous investment in growth businesses," and "strengthening the management foundation that supports growth."

In the Healthcare Business, it offers skincare brands such as "Korāju Furufuru" and "Korāju Ripea".
entries.67cea0e7d2621713: In the Pharmaceutical Business, it actively carries out information provision activities centered on its flagship products, focusing on cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, obstetrics and gynecology, and psychiatry. In the Healthcare Business, it aims to open up markets on the basis of strong support from dermatologists, obstetricians and gynecologists, and nurses, among others. In research and development, it actively promotes alliances with companies in Japan and overseas, and focuses intensively on drug discovery research for new modalities such as siRNA drugs.

entries.a23aaf2b6da7978b: The company's only reportable segment is the Pharmaceutical Business. By business division, sales were ¥109,042 million for the Pharmaceutical Business and ¥7,908 million for the Healthcare Business, and the Pharmaceutical Business accounted for the bulk of consolidated revenue of ¥116,951 million. Sales are made through pharmaceutical wholesalers, and the main customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were Medicheo Co., Ltd. (¥28,156 million, 24.1% of consolidated revenue), Alfresa Corporation (¥18,081 million, 15.5%), Suzuken Co., Ltd. (¥17,252 million, 14.8%) and Tōhō Yakuhin Co., Ltd. (¥10,333 million, 8.8%). Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue.

entries.ed45c5c6f6c90743: This business handles prescription pharmaceuticals. The company entrusts the manufacture of pharmaceuticals to its subsidiary Mochida Seiyaku Kōjō Co., Ltd., and purchases and sells those products. It also purchases and sells products from its subsidiary Mochida Seiyaku Hanbai Co., Ltd. For some pharmaceuticals, Mochida Seiyaku Hanbai Co., Ltd. purchases from the company and from its equity-method affiliate Andpharma Co., Ltd. and sells them, and for some medical devices, its U.S. subsidiary Mochida Medical USA, Inc. purchases from the company and sells them. Mochida Seiyaku Kōjō Co., Ltd. entrusts part of the manufacture of pharmaceuticals to its subsidiary Technofine Co., Ltd. General affairs work is handled by its subsidiary Mochida Heartful Service Co., Ltd., and the company also outsources this work to it.
